title: Face Unlock
status.noSensor: This laptop has no presence sensor
status.sensorOff: The presence sensor is not running
setup.missing: Face unlock needs a one-time setup: it installs Howdy for face recognition, teaches it your face and connects it to the lock screen. It asks for your password.
setup.outdated: The plugin was updated. Run setup again to update the parts it installed on the system.
wake.label: Wake on approach
wake.description: Wake the locked screen when you approach.
lock.label: Lock on leave
awake.label: Stay awake while you watch
awake.description: No screensaver or idle lock while you look at the screen.
saverInput.label: Any input ends the screensaver
saverInput.description: Touch, touchpad and keys like Shift end it too.
saverPresence.label: End the screensaver when the sensor sees you
saverPresence.description.off: The sensor leaves the screensaver alone.
saverPresence.description.return: It ends when you sit down, or look back at the screen after looking away.
saverPresence.description.watching: It ends whenever you are seen looking at the screen, also right after you start it yourself.
attention.label: Wait until you look
attention.description: Scan for your face only while you look at the screen.
settings.title: Face Unlock Settings
settings.noSensor: Presence settings need a working presence sensor.
prompts.label: Use for sudo
prompts.description: Also accept your face for sudo and admin prompts.
